# PromptForge Cinematic — Copilot Instructions

Project: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Lenis.

Language: French only.

Design target:
- cinematic scroll-driven website
- game/movie launch website feeling
- GTA VI / Rockstar-style presentation energy
- MotionSites/Awwwards-level art direction
- dark premium, immersive, media-first
- no generic SaaS layout
- no dashboard
- no boring cards
- no random blobs
- no cheap glassmorphism

Build philosophy:
- design first
- one strong visual idea per section
- scroll tells a story
- big typography
- fullscreen scenes
- cinematic transitions
- smooth motion
- mobile must remain clean

Performance rules:
- use GSAP cleanup
- no React state updates every frame
- use transform and opacity
- avoid heavy blur everywhere
- respect prefers-reduced-motion
- no horizontal overflow

Accessibility:
- semantic HTML
- one h1
- visible focus states
- French aria labels
- readable contrast
- reduced motion support
